title: Transfer | Bioreactor Logistic Growth Fit
goal: Use optical-density measurements from a batch bioreactor to fit a logistic growth curve, estimate lag-adjusted growth behavior and carrying capacity, and report the predicted harvest window when biomass crosses a target threshold.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the skill to sigmoidal growth modeling, where the main work is nonlinear parameter estimation from noisy time-series data. `curve_fit` is the unique shipped capability that makes the task possible.
